mistake_reason: At step 9, WebSurfer explicitly committed to counting only visible images on the rendered 2022 revision excluding icons/navboxes. At step 10, WebSurfer contradicted that plan by switching to counting [[File:...]] occurrences in the wikitext (View Source), which included a footer/portal icon and other template elements. This reasoning-action mismatch (FM-2.6) led to an inflated and incorrect count that was then propagated as the final answer.
